## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue.

## Type of Change
- [ ] New connector added (e.g. new tube/gif/anime provider)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds UI or aggregation functionality)
- [ ] Optimization / Refactor

## How Has This Been Tested?
- [ ] Ran `npm run test:connectors`
- [ ] Tested in All18 grid mode
- [ ] Tested in TikTok vertical feed mode
- [ ] Tested in 𝕏 timeline mode
- [ ] Tested on mobile responsive viewport

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or TypeScript errors
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README accordingly
